metrics.visualTitle: Default rate by year and age group

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year],
			'Customers'[Age Group],
			'Customers'[Age Group Order],
			"Default_Rate", 'Loans'[Default Rate]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0PrimaryDbCount = 
		CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Date'[Year])))

	VAR __DS0SecondaryDbCount = 
		CALCULATE(
			COUNTROWS(SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Customers'[Age Group], 'Customers'[Age Group Order]))
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			'Date'[Year],
			[Default_Rate],
			350,
			'Customers'[Age Group Order],
			'Customers'[Age Group],
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0BodyBinnedSample, 'Customers'[Age Group], 'Customers'[Age Group Order])

	VAR __DS0SecondaryCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0SecondaryBase))

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
			__DS0BodyBinnedSample,
			"ColumnIndex",
			__DS0SecondaryBase,
			'Customers'[Age Group Order],
			ASC,
			'Customers'[Age Group],
			ASC
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount,
		"DS0PrimaryDbCount", __DS0PrimaryDbCount,
		"DS0SecondaryDbCount", __DS0SecondaryDbCount,
		"DS0SecondaryCount", __DS0SecondaryCount
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0SecondaryBase

ORDER BY
	'Customers'[Age Group Order], 'Customers'[Age Group]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year], [ColumnIndex]

metrics.visualTitle: Default rate by education and employment type

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Customers'[Education], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Customers'[EmploymentType], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			"Default_Rate", 'Loans'[Default Rate]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			102,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Customers'[Education], [IsGrandTotalRowTotal]),
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Customers'[Education],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Customers'[EmploymentType], [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 1, 'Customers'[EmploymentType], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal],
				ASC,
				'Customers'[EmploymentType],
				ASC
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core),
			AND([IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"MinDefault_Rate", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Default_Rate]),
		"MaxDefault_Rate", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Default_Rate])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 'Customers'[EmploymentType]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'Customers'[Education], [ColumnIndex]

DEFINE

			),
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Customers'[Age Group Order],
			1,

			'Customers'[Income Band Order],

		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,

				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal],
				ASC,
				'Customers'[Income Band Order],
				ASC,
